what: From when the panel enters the bottom of the screen until its center reaches the screen center, the corner radius changes. Straighten goes 79→0 (pill becomes bar), Round goes 0→79 (bar becomes pill), power2.inOut. Apply one to each of two side-by-side panels and they swap shapes with each other.

options.to: square (default — from round to straight) or round (from straight to round)
options.radius: Radius at its roundest (px at 1440 width, scales with window width), default 79
options.[data-fx-part=plate]: (If present) panel (child) whose corners change. If absent, the element itself
